transcription: Accused of cheating for a total accident, me 23 and my girlfriend 21 have been dating for about six years. She is an amazing person and we have had few issues throughout our relationship and have made awesome memories together. So we are doing long distance a couple hours away at the moment due to school and my girlfriend came down for the weekend. We had a great time and after she left I had to do my laundry at the laundromat to get ready for the next day. When I get home and was putting clothes away, I find my GFS underwear in my room and thought I would give them back when she came down again. I put them on my dresser and forget about them. Three weeks later she comes down again and I see the underwear on my dresser and say hey you forgot your underwear. She looks at them and goes, those aren't mine. Why did you hand me another chick's panties? At this point I literally had no idea what she was talking about because they couldn't be anyone else's. She's the only girl I had in my room. Well, she seems to be pretty upset about it and I tell her I must have picked them up from the laundromat when I did laundry. I mean this does sound like a really lame excuse, but it's was the truth because there is no other way they could have gotten in my room. I don't know what else to tell her other than I never cheated on her. I know it's really freaking stupid of me but it was a complete accident. I quit to do anymore.
